messages.text:
Hi Georges,

I want to say this in front of everyone copied here: you've been top-notch
every time I've dealt with you. When my DIMO unit needed replacing, you had
it on its way the next day with tracking, and you've always answered my
questions straight. You're an example of how a company should treat its
customers, and I'm grateful for it.

That's why I'm coming straight to you. I'd like you to take over my 4DSKY
RMA and be my point of contact from here on. It has stalled with no
communication at all, and I need someone I can count on to get it to the
finish line.

Here's where things stand:
- Sep 14: Mike sent the return label and said Helium Deploy was receiving
my replacement from Jetvision and would ship it as soon as it came in.
- Sep 15: I shipped the broken unit the next day, as promised.
- Sep 18: USPS shows it delivered to your Chattanooga, TN returns facility
at 9:20 AM ET (tracking ····, ····).
- Sep 21: I followed up with Mike asking for confirmation and a ship date.
No reply.
- Today, Oct 5: Still nothing. No receipt confirmation, no update, no
tracking.

You've had my unit for over two weeks, and I've done everything asked of me
on time. Going completely silent on a customer isn't acceptable, especially
when Helium Deploy is the reseller representing Neuron and 4DSKY.

Could you please:
1. Confirm in writing that my returned unit (····) was received.
2. Get me a firm ship date and tracking number for the replacement, or tell
me plainly what's holding it up with Jetvision.

I'd appreciate hearing back by end of day Wednesday, Oct 7. Mike, Abel, and
the Neuron team are copied so everyone is on the same page.

Thanks again, Georges. I really appreciate your help.

Shawn
(phone hidden)
Handed to the team · RMA receipt not logged anywhere on our side and no replacement date exists; supp

Hi Shawn,

Thank you for the kind words, and I'm sorry you've been left without an answer since September. Going quiet on you after you did everything asked of you on time is not acceptable, and I'm not going to defend it.

Here is what I can confirm now. Your return on USPS (number hidden) shows delivered to our Chattanooga returns facility on September 18 at 9:20 AM ET, and I have put that confirmation on your file against ····, along with your Airsquitter orders Shop···· and Shop····. What I cannot see on our side is the check-in of that unit against the RMA, and no replacement has been booked or shipped yet. I'm not going to invent a ship date or a tracking number to fill that gap.

So I've handed this to Georges directly and asked him to be your point of contact, exactly as you requested. The team is offline right now and picks this up at 10am ET tomorrow. You'll get his reply by email, with written confirmation of the receipt, and either a firm ship date and tracking for the replacement or a straight account of what is holding it up on the supplier side. That is well inside your Wednesday deadline.

Nothing more is needed from you in the meantime.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
